doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Joining Jay McShann in Vallejo, replacing Walter Brown
summary: After service he joined Jay McShann in Vallejo, replacing singer Walter Brown, and still plays with McShann.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well that’s really interesting. And when you got out of the service, you came back to, did you end up in Kansas City or did you —
Then that’s where I joined Jay McShann. Actually, that’s where the mess started.
Would you do it again? Who did you replace, or did he have a singer before you?
Walter Brown, and he had some other singer for a little while. But really it was Walter Brown.
He had had a few records that were fairly well known, right?
But it wasn’t long before you had your own.
With Jay McShann playing piano. He came and did that for me. I just got through having breakfast with him.
